author: TheColdCrafter
body:
Application
Age: 14, nearly 15
Timezone: EST
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No:  Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?
I have not had much experience in the field of moderating, however i have had some. On a server owned and run by Rezachi, i was Helper, then promoted to mod, then promoted to head-mod for a good while,
though i was demoted due to inactivity, that is because I wanted to dedicate more time to avicus so that i could try to help out and eventually apply for mod :). In the time that I was a mod/head-mod on the server,
i was a very active, friendly and likeable staff member. I have also had a small amount of experience moderating forums before, but that was on multiple forums that ended up dying at the end, but I was pretty
efficient in terms of keeping the forums cleans and making sure everyone followed the rules.


What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
I very rarely lose my cool at people, but I have been improving at this and I believe that at this moment in time that I can control myself better than ever before, and I can keep it under check.
Obviously, this would affect my moderating by making me not look like a role model, or a leader in any way, which is a huge part of being a moderator, but I believe I can hold this down 
and keep myself under check. My biggest strength is being active and dedicated, and this can help the moderating team because a lot of people have been complaining about inactivity on the staff team, and I believe I could make a big difference in that.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
To start off, i am very active as you can see here - https://gyazo.com/45ea61433e8a575e6de10f36d12ba803. I have been dedicated to Avicus for a very long time.
Also i am very good at catching hackers, as you can see by my reports - https://gyazo.com/b278755f9c89d9a5d136111657eaa2f3 , I am very proud of my accomplishments in this field.
Also I can be a good leader when it is necessary, and I can enforce the rules in a calm, but forceful manner if necessary. I have had experience in this field before.
I am also very good at detecting hacks, as almost all of my reports are legitimate hackers, and i usually get what type of hacks they are using correct, so I would say that I am good at hack detecting.
I also know most of the guidelines and what punishments need to be dealt for each offense, since I often carefully study the punishments tab, so that I can learn more about what I could potentially be getting myself into.
I have learned alot and matured alot since the last time i applied, as i was a very immature person back then. But i believe i could be a productive and active member of the staff team as of now.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
A leader needs to be someone who can be looked up to as a role model, they need to be someone who can make sure everyone is doing what is right, they also need to be able to take control of a situation
when it is necessary, but most importantly, a leader needs to be someone that you can trust to always make the right decision, regardless of the situation. I do consider myself to be a pretty good leader,
as I am good at keeping situations under check, and often I can be looked up to as a role model in terms of my behavior and my morals, and I can definently be trusted.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
I am a lot more active than most players, I am actually very good at hack detecting and am very dedicated to catching hackers and doing my best to keep the server under check, especially when
there are no mods on, And i dont get stuck in flame wars always arguing with everyone, which I consider to be a very important quality of a moderator.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
You just need the ability to stay calm and be able to argue in a civilized manner if an argument starts. You also need to sometimes just ignore them, since some people will just try to bring you down,
regardless of what you do. Also, you need to just be a nice person, as the community-staff relations should improves as long as you can maintain a good reputation. I do believe i have these skills because
I have been displaying them for a while now. and can hold strong if I get moderator.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
I am generally on for about 2-4 hours on weekdays,  and 3-7 hours on weekends, so probably around 16-20 hours a week, maybe more if there is no school.

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
Make sure to stay online so that I can continue dealing with him, but make sure that every time I record and get evidence for him hacking. I would record him, freeze him, and if he continues to leave and come back,
then I would just continue to record him every time as to get sufficient evidence, and freeze him. I would also do everything in my power to get a mod on so that we can 100% deal with the problem.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?
Ask him to stop politely, and if he doesn't stop, maybe kick him. if he still doesn't stop, or starts harrassing me as well, I would probably bring this staff member to the Senior staffs attention, so that
we can make sure that whoever is doing this will stop for good.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?
That is a tough one. I could show their infraction history, which could possibly be evidence that they are known for doing things such as the thing they are appealing, but most likely I would have to tell them that
there is no evidence file, and they would get a 2nd chance, but they would be under strict watch to make sure they don't do whatever they did again.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
I may ask the seniors about the situation and I would leave it up to them as to whether or not to punish this staff member, as I know leaking is not allowed, but it may not be something very important,
so I would just check with the Seniors to see what they think about this. I would also remind the staff member that doing things like this is a bad idea, and tell him not to do it privately.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?
I can either try to argue why it is not a good decision, or I could try to take it up with some of the administration why this decision was made and ask if they could tell me.  But first, I would ask what
the circumstances in the situation were, which may make the decision end up seeming legitimate, or paint it in a better light. if it is still does not seem like a legitimate decision, then I would
most likely take the problem up with administrators


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
Getting moderator on avicus would mean everything to me. Ever since I joined avicus 3~4 years ago, it has been my #1 dream to get mod, but I just never had the qualifications. But i've put in some time
and work, and I believe I finally have what it takes to achieve this dream. I hope you think the same.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
I am very passionate about avicus. I have met some of my best friends on avicus, and for the most part, the community is nice and welcoming. I also enjoy playing on it and just talking to people, becausepeople on avicus are so much more fun than on other servers. Avicus is always what I first turn to when i open up minecraft, and I get excited every time i join, because I never know what is going to happen.


Do you speak any other languages than English?
Nope. I am working on learning German, but I am not very good at it yet.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?
 
Thanks for giving me this opportunity, and I hope you guys consider me :)
